locations.note: When a murder halts their TV drama shoot, director Rintaro Yagumo and actress Riho pick places around Matsue to investigate and question people.
The film crew scouts this real town as a possible shooting location, and its streets and landmarks appear in the investigation.
Rintaro and Riho visit Izumo while developing their television project and following the case.
The crew visits the coastal town of Mihonoseki, its shrine and its fishing harbour.
